title: Config
description: evals/litmustest.yaml. Where traces come from, how runs execute, how judges are trusted, what CI enforces, and where results go.

project.description: The project this evals/ folder belongs to.

format.description: otel and jsonl ship in Phase 1; the platform adapters are Phase 4.

path.description: A file or glob, relative to the repo root, for jsonl and otel. Ignored for platform formats.

project.description: For braintrust: the project id to pull logs from. Credentials come from the environment (BRAINTRUST_API_KEY; LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY, LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY, LANGFUSE_HOST).

sampler.description: How a review batch is drawn from the source.

clusters.description: Number of clusters; one representative per cluster, the rest random.

trials.description: Trials per task unless the task overrides.

budget_usd.description: Stop the run when spend crosses this.

environment.description: Where each trial runs. Harbor and docker give a clean container per trial.

default_model.description: Model used by a judge that does not pin its own. Must be a dated snapshot.

trust_threshold.description: TPR and TNR (percent) a judge needs on the held-out test set to be trusted.

stale_on_change.description: Mark a judge stale when its prompt hash or model changes.

correct_for_judge_error.description: Correct reported pass rates for the judge's measured TPR/TNR.

gates.description: Per-suite gates, keyed by suite name.

storage.description: Where run output goes. Summaries are small and go in git; transcripts are evidence and get a stable address.

pr_comment.description: Post the comparison as a PR comment.

base_run.description: Which run a CI run is compared against.

agent.description: How the runner starts the agent for one trial. The command runs once per trial in a fresh trial directory and must leave <trial_dir>/trial.json in the reference_solution shape (output, state, tool_calls, transcript, optional usage and latency_ms). Placeholders: {task}, {task_file}, {trial_dir}, {trial}, {evals}; the same values arrive as LITMUSTEST_TASK, LITMUSTEST_TASK_FILE, LITMUSTEST_TRIAL_DIR, LITMUSTEST_TRIAL, LITMUSTEST_INPUT (JSON) and LITMUSTEST_EVALS.

command.description: The command line, split on spaces (quotes respected), run without a shell.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the repo root. Default: the repo root.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the agent.

reset.description: Optional command run before each trial to reset external state (a database, a sandbox). Same placeholders.

coverage.description: Maps of the application that `litmustest coverage` measures the eval suite against. v1 measures three maps: spec (test-case ids in your docs), surface (API routes or tool names the trials actually call) and risk (failure modes by severity, always on). It does not measure production traffic, code lines or the frontend.

spec.description: Requirements: every match of id_pattern in these files is one item. A task covers an item through `covers:` or a `source: spec:<id>` (case-insensitive).

files.description: Paths or globs relative to the repository root.

id_pattern.description: A regular expression for one spec id, e.g. SYS-[A-Z]+-\\d+.

area_pattern.description: A regular expression with one capture group that picks the area from an id. Default: the id without its trailing number.

surface.description: What the product exposes. Items come from an OpenAPI file, a scan of route decorators, or an explicit list (tool names, for an agent). A route counts as exercised when a trial in the latest run calls it; `covers:` can also claim one.

openapi.description: Path to an OpenAPI JSON or YAML file, relative to the repository root.

scan.description: Globs of source files to scan for route decorators such as @app.get("/path") or router.post('/path').

items.description: An explicit list: "METHOD /path" or tool names.

ignore.description: Items to leave out, matched exactly or by a trailing *.

group_depth.description: How many path segments make an area for the chart. Default 2 (/api/play).

learn_more_url.description: Base URL of the Master Class guide. Learn more links go to <url>#ch-<n>; without it the chapter is named but not linked.

plain_language_default.description: Whether Plain language starts on for someone who has not chosen. Each person's own choice lives in ~/.config/litmustest/prefs.json, not here.
